name: JK synchro
summary: JK Synchro is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals by synchronizing multiple oscillator indicators (likely RSI, Stochastic, or similar) to identify aligned momentum shifts across different lookback periods. It enters trades when the synchronized momentum signals confirm a directional move and exits based on opposing signals or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: JK Synchro是一个基于动量的EA，通过同步多个振荡器指标来产生交易信号，识别不同回溯周期下对齐的动量转换。当同步动量信号确认方向性走势时入场，并在出现反向信号或固定止盈止损时出场。
strategy_analysis: JK Synchro策略的核心概念是通过多个动量振荡器的同步信号来确认交易方向，减少单一指标的假信号干扰。入场条件要求多个振荡器在超买或超卖区域同时发出同向信号，形成共振效应后才开仓，例如多个RSI或随机指标同时从超卖区上穿或从超买区下穿。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及反向同步信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的计算逻辑。资金管理方面较为薄弱，缺乏最大回撤控制、账户权益保护机制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减逻辑。整体策略依赖指标共振过滤噪音信号，但在趋势反转和震荡市中的适应性可能不足。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the JK Synchro strategy is to confirm trade direction through synchronized signals from multiple momentum oscillators, reducing false signals from any single indicator. Entry conditions require multiple oscillators to simultaneously emit aligned signals from overbought or oversold zones, creating a resonance effect before opening a position, such as multiple RSI or Stochastic indicators crossing up from oversold or crossing down from overbought simultaneously. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when opposing synchronized signals appear. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional calculation logic found. Money management is relatively weak, lacking maximum drawdown controls, account equity protection mechanisms, and position reduction logic after consecutive losses. The overall strategy relies on indicator resonance to filter noise signals, but adaptability in trend reversals and ranging markets may be insufficient.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 多指标同步信号有效减少假信号，提高入场准确率
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性较好便于优化
共振机制在强趋势行情中表现优异，能捕捉较大波段利润
pros_en: Multi-indicator synchronization effectively reduces false signals and improves entry accuracy
Strategy logic is clear and easy to understand with good parameter adjustability for optimization
Resonance mechanism performs excellently in strong trending markets, capturing substantial swing profits
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自适应调整
缺少资金保护机制如最大回撤限制和连续亏损处理
多指标同步条件在震荡市中可能频繁触发假信号导致反复亏损
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management and cannot adapt to account risk levels
Missing capital protection mechanisms such as maximum drawdown limits and consecutive loss handling
Synchronization conditions may trigger frequent false signals in ranging markets causing repeated losses
improvements: 引入动态仓位管理，基于账户权益百分比或ATR计算交易手数
增加震荡市场过滤机制如ADX趋势强度指标，避免在低趋势强度时开仓
improvements_en: Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR calculation for trade lots
Add ranging market filter such as ADX trend strength indicator to avoid opening positions during low trend strength

risk_points: 固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，大资金时风险敞口可能不足，小资金时可能过大
缺少最大回撤保护和连续亏损后自动减仓机制
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not account for account size changes, potentially under-exposing large accounts or over-exposing small accounts
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and automatic position reduction after consecutive losses
